BC Banking Correspondent
Banking Services

Apne ghar ke paas hi bank jaisee suvidha — Union Bank, Airtel aur Fino Payments Bank.

🏦

Union Bank of India

Account opening (Aadhaar & PAN se). Bachhon ke liye bhi account (18 saal se kam).

📶

Airtel Payments Bank

Turant account opening. Mobile number se linked, instant digital wallet & transfers.

💳

Fino Payments Bank

Zero balance account, direct benefit transfer support, aur easy withdrawals.

🔄

AEPS – Aadhaar Payment

Aadhaar Enabled Payment System dwara cash nikasi aur jama — bina bank gaye.

📊

Balance & Mini Statement

Account ka balance jaanen aur last transactions ki mini statement nikaalein.

💵

Cash Deposit & Withdrawal

Seedha cash jama ya nikasi — sabhi linked accounts ke liye fast processing.

⭐

Special Suvidha

Union Bank of India mein 18 saal se kam umar ke bachchon ka bhi account khola jaata hai. Sirf Aadhaar & PAN laayein — account turant ready!
